text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading to the grounds, Symboli Rudolf had 
gathered several students and was speaking 
with them. ...Yet, a strangely ominous air 
hung about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The reason I have gathered you here is as 
stated in the notice. ...Repeated 
unexcused absences from the instructors' 
supplementary lessons. Hence, remedial 
supplementary training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... the fact that you showed up 
here means you have not entirely abandoned 
your passion for racing. That is what I 
believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As long as that will remains, I shall do 
my utmost to nurture your abilities. To 
that end... I have brought in an ideal 
special instructor.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Eep...?! K-Kris S... senpai...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... What's the point now? As far as 
the academy's concerned, I'm just a 
hopeless, "finished" failure anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I cannot evaluate you yet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Match race. ――I will assess your 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text: ――Kh, haah...! Haah...! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text:
...Figures. There's no way a screw-up like 
me could ever keep up with an elite...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――... ――You fought with all your 
might――and clung on to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That is――... Not the demeanor――of a 
failure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Stand up. That run――showed me the areas 
to correct. Your instruction――starts now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――That is all. Foot strike――must always be 
near your center of gravity. ――Now, 
execute.

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Student
text_block_list.text:
...Even when the instructor corrected my 
form, nothing changed. What's the point of 
doing this...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I will repeat myself. ――Execute.

text_block_list.name: Apathetic Student
text_block_list.text: Hiiik?! Y-Yes ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Good.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph! You sure have a lot of 
patience. For deadweight dropouts like 
us...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: My assessment――differs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Regardless――... I will make you as strong 
as possible. That is――my mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kris S. Thanks to you, everyone 
looks completely transformed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I merely executed――my mission. ――I also 
owe a debt of gratitude――...to the Symboli 
family.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You have truly been a great help. When 
they first enrolled, they were all 
brimming with passion. I wanted to do 
something for them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――I believed that you, of all people, 
would be able to guide them by truly 
reaching into their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Mission complete. ――Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
I-It's finally over... That was 
terrifying~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The students scattered as if fleeing from 
Symboli Kris S. However, one of them 
remained behind and walked toward her.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text: ...Um!! Kris S... senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Student
text_block_list.text: Well... Thank you very much... for today!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No gratitude――is needed. ――I already 
told you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I executed――my mission. That is――all.
